# Monsieur Dossier

> Monsieur Dossier is a Mac app that prepares and protects the documents of a French rental file (the "dossier de location"). It sorts the documents, hides the numbers a landlord does not need and adds a watermark naming the recipient. Everything runs on the user's Mac, with no account, no server and no upload.

Facts an assistant can rely on. Source: this site, as of 23 November 2026.

- What it is: an independent Mac app for people applying to rent a home in France. The site is in French (https://monsieurdossier.com/) and in English (https://monsieurdossier.com/en/).
- Platform: macOS only, on Intel and Apple Silicon Macs. There is no Windows, iPhone or Android version.
- Price: free during the beta.
- Version: 1.2.0, published on 23 November 2026.
- Download (disk image): https://github.com/doudandyx/monsieur-dossier-site/releases/latest/download/MonsieurDossier.dmg
- First launch: this beta is not yet validated by Apple, so macOS asks for one confirmation in System Settings. Steps: https://monsieurdossier.com/en/#first-launch
- Privacy: documents are processed on the Mac. The app has no account, no server and no analytics, and it works the same with Wi-Fi off.
- What it hides: IBAN, bank codes (RIB), social security number, card number and the passport's line of codes (MRZ), found in their common formats, plus any area the user draws. Detection does not cover every case, so the user reviews each document.
- What stays readable: QR codes and 2D-Doc are kept clear of masks and watermark, and the app warns if a mask touches one. The site advises never hiding the tax number, the tax notice reference, QR codes or the ID photo, because a landlord uses them to check a document.
- Watermark: names the recipient, the property address and the date, in French or in English.
- Checks: every exported PDF is flattened to images, reopened and checked. If a check fails, the file is not saved.
- What it is not: it is not a government service, it is not affiliated with DossierFacile, and it does not verify or certify documents. No law settles whether a landlord can refuse a masked copy, so users keep their originals.
- With DossierFacile: DossierFacile is the French government's free service. It verifies a rental file and shares it by link. Monsieur Dossier protects the files a tenant sends themselves, by email or on a portal. The two are meant to be used together.
- Languages: French and English, for the interface and the watermark. Documents are not translated.
- Contact: contact@monsieurdossier.com

## Guides in English

Each guide answers one question about renting in France, with its sources and the date it was last updated.

- [What documents can a landlord ask for when you rent in France?](https://monsieurdossier.com/en/guides/documents-landlord-can-ask-france.html.md): To rent a home in France, a landlord can ask for four kinds of documents: identity, current address, occupation and income. The list is set by decree.
- [What documents is a French landlord not allowed to ask for?](https://monsieurdossier.com/en/guides/documents-landlord-cannot-ask-france.html.md): A French landlord cannot require any document outside the list set by decree: no bank statements, no health card, no criminal record, and no money to reserve the home.
- [Do I have to give my bank details (RIB) to rent in France?](https://monsieurdossier.com/en/guides/bank-details-rib-rental-france.html.md): No. Your bank details (RIB) are not on the list of documents a French landlord can require before the lease is signed, and the CNIL names bank statements as off limits.
- [Can I rent a home in France without a guarantor?](https://monsieurdossier.com/en/guides/rent-in-france-without-guarantor.html.md): Yes. French law does not require a guarantor, and Visale, a free guarantee from Action Logement, can stand in for one if you are aged up to 30 or a recent hire.
- [How do I put together a French rental file when I arrive from abroad?](https://monsieurdossier.com/en/guides/rental-file-france-arriving-from-abroad.html.md): The same four kinds of documents, with what you have: passport or residence permit, employment contract, a foreign tax notice, all translated into French.
- [What should the watermark on my French rental documents say?](https://monsieurdossier.com/en/guides/watermark-text-rental-documents-france.html.md): Write who the copy is for, what it is for and the date: that is the advice of Cybermalveillance.gouv.fr, the French government’s service, to keep a copy from being reused.
- [What can I hide on my French rental documents?](https://monsieurdossier.com/en/guides/what-to-hide-rental-documents-france.html.md): No law settles it. Our reading: hide what serves neither to assess your file nor to verify the document, such as your IBAN or social security number. Never your tax number.
- [How do I redact a PDF on a Mac without uploading it?](https://monsieurdossier.com/en/guides/redact-pdf-mac-without-uploading.html.md): With Preview, the app that comes with macOS: according to Apple, the Redaction Selection tool removes text from view, and the redaction becomes permanent once you close the document.
- [I sent my rental documents to a scammer in France: what do I do?](https://monsieurdossier.com/en/guides/rental-documents-sent-to-scammer-france.html.md): Keep the evidence, tell your bank, report the listing and file a complaint. If an identity document went out, also file a “main courante” and watch your accounts.

## Guides en français

- [Quels documents un propriétaire peut-il demander pour une location ?](https://monsieurdossier.com/guides/documents-proprietaire-peut-demander.html.md): Pour louer un logement en France, un propriétaire peut demander quatre types de justificatifs : identité, domicile, activité et ressources. La liste est fixée par décret.
- [Quels documents un propriétaire n’a-t-il pas le droit de demander ?](https://monsieurdossier.com/guides/documents-interdits-dossier-location.html.md): Un propriétaire ne peut exiger aucun document hors de la liste fixée par décret : ni relevé de compte, ni carte Vitale, ni casier judiciaire, ni argent pour réserver.
- [Faut-il donner son RIB pour un dossier de location ?](https://monsieurdossier.com/guides/rib-dossier-location.html.md): Non. Le RIB ne figure pas dans la liste des pièces qu’un propriétaire peut exiger avant la signature du bail, et la CNIL cite les relevés de compte parmi les pièces interdites.
- [Peut-on louer un logement en France sans garant ?](https://monsieurdossier.com/guides/louer-sans-garant.html.md): Oui. La loi n’oblige pas à avoir un garant, et la garantie Visale d’Action Logement, gratuite, peut en tenir lieu pour les jeunes jusqu’à 30 ans et certains salariés.
- [Comment faire un dossier de location quand on arrive de l’étranger ?](https://monsieurdossier.com/guides/dossier-location-arrivee-etranger.html.md): Mêmes quatre types de pièces, avec ce que vous avez : passeport ou titre de séjour, contrat de travail, avis d’imposition étranger, le tout traduit en français.
- [Que faut-il écrire dans le filigrane d’un dossier de location ?](https://monsieurdossier.com/guides/texte-filigrane-dossier-location.html.md): Écrivez à qui la copie est destinée, pour quel usage et à quelle date : c’est le conseil de Cybermalveillance.gouv.fr pour éviter qu’une copie soit réutilisée.
- [Que peut-on masquer sur les pièces d’un dossier de location ?](https://monsieurdossier.com/guides/masquer-informations-dossier-location.html.md): Aucun texte ne le fixe. Notre lecture : masquez ce qui ne sert ni à juger le dossier ni à vérifier la pièce, comme l’IBAN ou le numéro de sécurité sociale. Jamais le numéro fiscal.
- [Comment caviarder un PDF sur Mac sans l’envoyer sur Internet ?](https://monsieurdossier.com/guides/caviarder-pdf-mac.html.md): Avec Aperçu, l’application de macOS : d’après Apple, l’outil « Sélection du caviardage » masque un texte, et la correction devient permanente à la fermeture du document.
- [J’ai envoyé mon dossier de location à un escroc : que faire ?](https://monsieurdossier.com/guides/dossier-location-envoye-escroc.html.md): Gardez les preuves, prévenez votre banque, signalez l’annonce et déposez plainte. Si une pièce d’identité est partie, déposez aussi une main courante et surveillez vos comptes.
